column1: # Module 04 — automate the boring stuff. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
File-automation safety laws: {{c1::dry-run first}} · {{c2::quarantine, never delete}} · {{c3::practise in a sandbox}} · {{c4::idempotent}}.
Idempotent = {{c1::running twice changes nothing the second time}}.
pathlib join: {{c1::repo / "PROGRESS.md"}} — never {{c2::glue path strings with +}}.
Copy with timestamps {{c1::shutil.copy2}} · move {{c2::shutil.move}} · zip {{c3::shutil.make_archive(name, "zip", folder)}}
Collect list(p.iterdir()) before moving because {{c1::never mutate a folder while iterating it}}.
re.compile buys {{c1::a named, reusable, once-built pattern}}.
csv.DictReader: rows as {{c1::dicts keyed by the header}}; values ALWAYS {{c2::strings}}.
Windows file gotchas: {{c1::encoding="utf-8" on open}} · {{c2::newline="" when WRITING csv}}.
subprocess.run law: pass {{c1::a LIST of args, never a glued shell string}} — gluing breeds injection.
Task Scheduler demystified: {{c1::trigger + action + working directory}}.
